Package com.kerosene.kfe.wallet.adapters.in.observation

Class KfeBitcoinZmqWatcher

java.lang.Object
com.kerosene.kfe.wallet.adapters.in.observation.KfeBitcoinZmqWatcher
All Implemented Interfaces:
org.springframework.context.Lifecycle, org.springframework.context.Phased, org.springframework.context.SmartLifecycle
@Component @ConditionalOnProperty(name="kfe.bitcoin.zmq.enabled", havingValue="true") public class KfeBitcoinZmqWatcher extends Object implements org.springframework.context.SmartLifecycle
Option 1: subscribe to Bitcoin Core ZMQ hashblock (+ optional rawtx), filter against monitored cold addresses, and kick a debounced observe/balance refresh.

Poll-based KfeOnchainBalanceSyncService / KfeColdWalletObservationService remain the safety net if ZMQ is down or events are missed.

  • Constructor Details

    • KfeBitcoinZmqWatcher

      public KfeBitcoinZmqWatcher(KfeMonitoredChainAddressIndex addressIndex, KfeColdWalletReactiveRefreshService refreshService, org.springframework.beans.factory.ObjectProvider<KfeColdWalletObservationService> coldObservationService, org.springframework.beans.factory.ObjectProvider<KfeCustodialDepositObservationService> custodialDepositObservationService, @Value("${kfe.bitcoin.zmq.hashblock:}") String hashblockEndpoint, @Value("${kfe.bitcoin.zmq.rawtx:}") String rawtxEndpoint, @Value("${kfe.bitcoin.zmq.subscribe-rawtx:true}") boolean subscribeRawTx, @Value("${bitcoin.network:mainnet}") String bitcoinNetwork)
      Configures optional ZMQ subscriptions and resolves the script-decoding network. Blank endpoint values are normalized to absent values; actual workers start only when the kfe.bitcoin.zmq.enabled conditional property enables this component.
      Parameters:
      addressIndex - monitored cold-wallet address and funding-transaction index
      refreshService - debounced block and touched-wallet refresh scheduler
      coldObservationService - optional cold-wallet raw-transaction observer
      custodialDepositObservationService - optional custodial/internal deposit observer
      hashblockEndpoint - endpoint for hashblock subscription, blank to disable it
      rawtxEndpoint - endpoint for raw transaction subscription, blank to disable it
      subscribeRawTx - whether to subscribe to raw transactions
      bitcoinNetwork - Bitcoin network name used to decode output addresses

      public void start()
      Starts the configured topic workers once, after attempting to rebuild the monitored-address index. Missing endpoints leave the component idle; index rebuild failure is logged and does not prevent block notifications or subsequent address-based refreshes from operating.
